summary: Dinosaur Smash: Cars & Dinos! 18 cars for kids. Play offline & learn!
description:
Indulge your child in a thrilling world of cars and dinosaurs with "Dinosaur Smash: Bumper Cars". Unleash the power of 18 distinct bumper cars, from the fiery truck to the authoritative police car, each tailored to ignite your child's imagination. Dive deep into responsive environments, ensuring the dinosaurs meet their fate via an alien's UFO tractor beam.

Crafted especially for children aged 2-5, this educational game promotes learning through play. But who says adults can't join the fun? Dive in, with or without your child, for a unique play experience. Explore an array of vivid locations, from the moon's cratered surface to ancient Indian temples. Plus, you're not bound by Wi-Fi. Play offline, anytime and anywhere, ensuring the fun never stops.

Key Features:
• Educational Gameplay: Enhance Pre-K activities with cars games designed for toddlers to kindergarteners.
• Diverse Vehicle Selection: From trucks to the unique Coke-Mobile, there's a vehicle for every young adventurer.
• Stunning Animations & Effects: Watch as each scene comes to life, kindling awe and wonder.
• Offline Capability: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Dive into the game whenever, wherever.
• Safe & Sound: Ad-free, kid-friendly sound effects ensure a smooth gaming journey.
• Learning through Play: Harnessing the power of fun to fuel education.
